ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Amendment); Administrative Measures for the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Customer Due Diligence of Financial Institutions (PBOC Order No. 1 [2024]); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owners of Companies (SAMR Order No. 81 [2024], effective November 1, 2024); PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 (November 1, 2024) on Beneficial Owner Identification and Registration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation or other competent company registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If issued by a state party to the Hague Apostille Convention: notarize domestically, then obtain an Apostille from the competent authority of that state; do not add consular legalization. If issued by a non-member state: notarize domestically, then authenticate by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and legalize by the Consulate/Embassy of the People's Republic of China in that state; do not add apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or corporate affairs authority in the foreign parent's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Same parallel path as any Hague Apostille Convention document: Apostille only if the issuing state is an Apostille member; otherwise, chain MFA authentication and Chinese consular legalization only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution authorizing the establishment of the WFOE and appointing the first legal representative and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign parent company (notarized by a local notary public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille if the parent's state is an Apostille Convention party; otherwise consular legalization via the Chinese embassy/consulate. The resolution must be notarized before either path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the Foreign Parent Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or statutory corporate registry of the parent's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille where the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille member; consular legalization where it is not. Do not combine both methods sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming the foreign investor's banking history, KYC status and financial standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Settlement bank or relationship bank of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a notary public followed by Apostille if the bank's country is an Apostille member; followed by MFA authentication plus Chinese consular legalization if the bank's country is not an Apostille member.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Each disclosed UBO, director, legal representative, supervisor and senior manager must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Chinese domestic list of persons subject to financial sanctions and terrorism financing. PEP status must be determined against sources including the Global PEP List and domestic official publications; enhanced due diligence is required for all foreign PEPs and at minimum standard due diligence for domestic PEPs. Screening must be continuous, with alerts re-run within 24 hours of any sanctions list update, and all results documented in the AML compliance file for retention of not less than five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (国家企业信用信息公示系统) and the SAIC State Administration for Market Regulation Name Pre-Approval online platform via the Shanghai or local Market Regulation Bureau one-stop portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Legal names must be registered in Simplified Chinese characters for the official Chinese company name, and the English name may be registered separately in Latin characters but may not be the sole registered name. The four-tier naming formula is mandatory: administrative division + unique distinctive name + industry or operating characteristics + company type (e.g., 北京/上海 + trademark/distinctive term + 医疗科技/咨询 + 有限公司). The distinctive section must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or a protected trademark; pinyin transliteration is permitted only as an English ancillary name and cannot replace Chinese ideographic characters. The Chinese name and the English transliteration must be submitted together in Form 1 and the transliteration doctrine requires the English spelling to correspond to the Chinese pinyin syllables of the distinctive section, except where a registered foreign trademark is used as the distinctive section, in which case the original Latin script may be retained.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Market Regulation Administration rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration petition with the superior market regulation authority within sixty days of receipt of the written rejection notice, or within six months directly institute an administrative lawsuit with the competent People's Court. The petition must include the original rejection decision, a redrafted name with supporting distinctive-section evidence, and a memorandum citing the Administrative Licensing Law and the Enterprise Name Registration Administration Provisions. The applicant should simultaneously submit a backup name application through the online name pre-approval system to avoid interrupting the incorporation timeline, and may request an oral hearing if the basis for rejection involves a disputed trademark or identical-name conflict.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office and commercial mailbox arrangements are generally impermissible for a WFOE whose registered address must be a fixed physical address within the jurisdiction with a lease or ownership document submitted to the market regulation authority and the tax authority. For a medical device regulatory consulting company, the tax authority and the market regulation authority may further require a physical presence showing a dedicated office space, business license display, and employee desk presence; a pure virtual mailbox service will not satisfy the commercial substance requirements for value-added tax invoicing and for the Industry and Commerce annual reporting. A registered address obtained from a lawful address-holding service may be accepted only if it provides a physical room, not merely a virtual mailbox, and if the service provider has a legitimate commercial housing lease that is recorded with the local street office; however, banks will commonly reject a virtual-office address for opening a corporate bank account and require a site inspection, so an independent brick-and-mortar office is the safest operational choice.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) Confirm the registered address appears on the business license and matches the lease contract, property/land use certificate and the enterprise information disclosure system; (2) Display the business license, tax registration and relevant regulatory consulting credentials at the registered address; (3) Maintain lease receipts, utility invoices, employee attendance and payroll records; (4) Ensure a designated person is present at the registered address during business hours; (5) keep original incorporation and license documents at the address; (6) file truthful annual reports and update changes within 30 days. Quantified risk: the probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the market regulation authority or municipal tax authority in the first year is moderate, approximately 15percent-25percent for newly established limited companies in regulated consulting sectors, rising to 30percent-40percent if the corporate address is shared with other companies or flagged in public database matching reviews. The tax bureau may conduct an address verification prior to granting general taxpayer status, electronic invoicing allocation or export tax rebate qualifications. Annual report and random inspection systems make on-site verification a routine compliance risk, not a rare event.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAMR company name pre-approval and registration administrative fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation and local Market Regulation Administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official registration fee is charged by the national registry; administrative cost borne by the government. Service agents may charge a market fee but this entry is government registry fee and is zero.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign investor document notarization and translation into Chinese (certified translation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in foreign parent jurisdiction and a certified Chinese translation agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for notarial certification, certification of signature, and certified translation of five corporate instruments (approximately 300-500 USD market benchmark)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or Chinese consular legalization fees for the five-document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille authority in the issuer's jurisdiction or Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Chinese Consulate/Embassy for consular legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular fee schedules and apostille tariffs vary by jurisdiction; market benchmark for five corporate documents ranges from 400-800 USD.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration filing and AML compliance documentation (beneficial owner information filing with SAMR)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SAMR-registered filing platform and local market regulation administration (no official fee); professional AML documentation support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory official fee for UBO registration under the new regulation; professional compliance support market benchmark 100-200 USD.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office lease deposit and first-year rental for a physical address meeting bank and tax substance requirements
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial lessor / real estate property owner in the municipality of registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a small office or registered address service with physical desk in tier-1 city approximately 400-800 USD per month, inclusive of one-month deposit and first-year rent; amount varies by city.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel fee for drafting Articles of Association, shareholder resolution and incorporation application review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for WFOE incorporation legal package (Chinese law firm) ranges from 2,000-4,000 USD.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate seal and chop engraving (company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and invoice seal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed seal engraving vendor approved by the local public security bureau
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for government-approved engraving and digital seal registration (approximately 100-200 USD).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2023, effective 1 July 2024), especially Articles 23, 24, 30, 32, 47 and 183; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 6, 30 and 31; Regulations on the Administration of Registration of Market Entities (State Council Decree No. 746).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Supervision Administration at the registered address; integrated municipal enterprise registration service hall or SAMR online enterprise registration platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (Market Entity Registration Application Form) jointly submitted to the local Market Supervision Administration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for an ISIC 7490 medical device regulatory consulting WFOE. Under the PRC Company Law (2023 Revision), the registered capital declared in the Articles of Association must be fully subscribed within five years from establishment unless a shorter period is specified in the Articles. No escrow or blocked account rule applies to consulting service WFOEs; the state does not require funds to be deposited in an escrow account before registration. Shareholders may inject capital to the company's capital account after issuance of the business license, in accordance with the subscription schedule.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN WFOE LTD

The undersigned directors, duly constituting a quorum at a meeting convened pursuant to the Articles of Association of CN WFOE LTD, a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company organized under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, having deliberated upon the proposals set out in the convening notice, hereby adopt the following resolutions by unanimous consent with proper corporate effect.

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: RESOLVED that the registered capital of the company be subscribed in accordance with the capital schedule stated in the Articles of Association; that the shareholders' subscription commitment be ratified; that each shareholder remit the subscribed capital to the company bank account no later than the fifth anniversary of the issuance of the business license, unless the Articles of Association require a shorter period; that upon receipt of capital contributions, the financial controller issue shareholder contribution certificates and update the statutory register of shareholders.

2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED that the company establish banking relations with a licensed commercial bank in the People's Republic of China; that the Legal Representative, or in his or her absence the General Manager, acting jointly with the Chief Financial Officer, be and is hereby authorized to open corporate bank accounts, execute account opening applications, sign banking mandates, and operate the accounts; that any payment exceeding RMB 500,000 shall require dual authorization from the Legal Representative and the Chief Financial Officer; that banking mandates remain effective until revoked by a subsequent resolution.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: RESOLVED that the registered office of the company be established at the address stated in the Articles of Association within the jurisdiction of the relevant Market Supervision Administration; that the lease agreement for such premises is approved; that the company seal affixation to the lease and all filings evidencing such registered office is ratified; and that all statutory correspondence shall be delivered to such address.

4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: RESOLVED that a named individual be appointed Executive Director and Legal Representative of the company with full power to represent the company in all dealings; that a named individual be appointed General Manager with responsibility for daily operations; that a named individual be appointed Chief Financial Officer with authority over accounting records and tax filings; and that a named individual be appointed Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with responsibility for maintaining statutory registers, filing annual reports, and ensuring regulatory compliance.

5. REGULATORY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: RESOLVED that the officers take all necessary actions to register the company for tax, value added tax, social insurance, and any applicable government admin systems, and to file all post-incorporation reports required by law.

6. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED that any two officers, one of whom must be the Legal Representative if available, be authorized to execute any applications, forms, affidavits, amendments, and correspondence required to perfect these resolutions.

The meeting was adjourned. The Chairperson declared the resolutions carried unanimously.

Signed by the Chairperson, Executive Director and Company Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Name Pre-Approval and Entity Type Nomination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration online enterprise registration platform or municipal enterprise service hall under SAMR.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the local Market Supervision Administration online portal or in-person service window. Provide three proposed variants of the company name, select the legal form as limited liability company, specify the registered capital amount, intended business scope, registered city, shareholder names, and proposed legal representative. The registry checks the proposed name against the national enterprise name database for duplication, misleading terms, and prohibited wording. For a WFOE in the medical device consulting field, the name should include an industry descriptive phrase reflecting regulatory consulting services. The authority issues a Name Pre-approval Notice valid for six months when approved. No fee is charged for name review, and no notarization is required at this preliminary stage.
required_dossiers: Passport or resident identity of proposed legal representative
Certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent shareholder
Power of attorney appointing the local agent for name filing
Written consent of any conflicting name holder if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a new name reservation with a more distinctive suffix or engage in a reconsideration request with the same market supervision office within five working days. If confusion with an existing enterprise is cited, provide a written no-objection letter from the prior name holder or select an alternative name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Executive of Constitutional Documents and Legalization of Foreign Shareholder Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chinese notary office with corporate records authority, local Justice Bureau, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs or consular legalization channel for offshore parent documentation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association and the sole shareholder resolution approving the formation of the WFOE. The foreign parent company's certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and board resolution approving the Chinese subsidiary must be notarized in the jurisdiction of the foreign parent and subsequently consular legalized or apostilled for use in China. Engage an authorized translation agency if the registry insists on a Chinese ancillary translation; the official legal dossier for this stage remains in English as the governing record. All signatures of the shareholders, legal representative, and directors must be verified before a Chinese notary where required. The notary issues a notarial certificate evidencing the validity of the foreign investor qualification and the execution of the corporate instruments. Delivery of the certificate is a condition precedent to final filing.
required_dossiers: Notarized and consular legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent
Board resolution of the foreign parent approving the investment
Power of attorney appointing the WFOE formation agent
Passport copies of all directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registration authority finds the foreign documents incomplete, obtain additional apostille or legalization from the issuing jurisdiction. If the Articles of Association deviate from SAMR standard templates, amend the text and convene the shareholder to countersign the revised Articles. A 10-working-day correction window applies normally.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration integrated service window or municipal digital government single-window portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the local SAMR enterprise registration system or appear at the municipal integrated registration hall. Complete the official Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, upload the fully executed Articles of Association, the notarized foreign investor documentation, shareholder lists, legal representative identity documents, the lease certificate or intended registered office address proof, and the name pre-approval notice. The registrar verifies statutory compliance, checks the capital contribution schedule, and upon approval issues the unified social credit code and business license. The business license constitutes conclusive evidence of incorporation and authorizes stamp making, bank account opening, and tax registration. Under the integration mechanism, the approved registration is automatically transmitted to tax, social insurance, statistics, and other administrative systems. Ensure the acceptance receipt is retained for SLA monitoring.
required_dossiers: Completed market entity establishment registration application
Notarial certificate of foreign investor qualifications
Certificate of registered office lease or right to use premises
Passports and identity documents of legal representative and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query or suspension, respond in writing within the stated deadline providing clarifications or supplementary documents. If the application is rejected, correct the grounds and re-submit within 15 working days. An administrative review appeal may be filed with the higher market supervision authority within 60 days from the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Engraving, Bank Account Opening and Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving service; licensed commercial bank chosen for banking; local tax service hall of the State Taxation Administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the business license, take the license certificate and the legal representative's passport to a Public Security Bureau-approved engraving shop to produce the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal. Record the seal filing number with the local public security organ. Next, open a RMB basic deposit account at a licensed commercial bank; if foreign capital contribution will be made in foreign currency, open a foreign currency capital account after completing the foreign direct investment foreign exchange registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the bank. Complete tax registration with the local in-charge tax authority and secure the taxpayer identification number under the unified social credit code. Register social insurance and housing fund for employees within the statutory timeline. Maintain organized records of all registration receipt numbers and digital certificates for subsequent annual filings.
required_dossiers: FDI foreign exchange registration documentation (for foreign currency capital opening)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank inquires into beneficial ownership or capital schedule, provide a cross-border shareholder organizational chart and the shareholder subscription resolution. If tax registration is delayed, file an application with the tax authority explaining excusable delay and pay any minimal late filing penalty as assessed. If the seal filing is objected to, re-submit the seal with a fresh license copy and police verification letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Statutory Compliance and Consulting Scope Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation annual report system; local tax authority; and, only if scope expands, the National Medical Products Administration or local commercial authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation is complete, access the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to file, on an annual basis, the enterprise annual report covering shareholder contributions, officers, financial data, and operating status. Confirm that the ISIC 7490 medical device regulatory consulting business does not require a separate industrial operating license, does not require an Environmental Impact Assessment, and does not require a Civil Defense fire permit. If any engagement requires handling of medical device samples or temporary warehousing, enter a specific client-side clearance and do not misrepresent the WFOE scope. Maintain a compliance file containing executed consulting agreements, confidentiality agreements, conflict-of-interest declarations, and any FDA or CE certification support records. If business scope later expands to physical testing, storage, or distribution of medical devices, an amendment application must be filed with SAMR and additional medical device business permits must be obtained.
required_dossiers: Contract templates for regulatory consulting services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual report is flagged as inconsistent, correct the filed data within the statutory correction period and submit a supplementary notice. If the tax authority identifies unreported liability, file an amended tax return and pay penalties promptly. If the registry determines that the actual business scope exceeds the licensed consulting framework, submit an amendment to scope or temporarily suspend the affected activity until approval is granted.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — pure digital and consulting services under ISIC 7490; no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing operation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — medical device FDA 510(k) filing and European CE Mark regulatory consulting does not constitute a licensed industrial or manufacturing activity under PRC operating license catalogues.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable — pure professional consulting; no EIA application required under the PRC Environmental Impact Assessment Law or the Classification Management List of Construction Project Environmental Impact Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no construction, production, discharge, or resource extraction is undertaken by CN WFOE LTD.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — no wastewater discharge, volatile organic compound emission source, or hazardous waste generation arises from regulatory consulting services. If client trial manufacturing occurs, the client facility, not CN WFOE LTD, must obtain pollutant discharge permits and comply with the Comprehensive Wastewater Discharge Standard and ambient air quality standards.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable — no fire safety certification, structural load inspection, or civil defense permit is required for an office-based consulting entity. General workplace safety obligations under the Labor Law and office fire safety rules of the commercial building still apply but require no special operating permit. If the entity later obtains a document warehouse, standard premises-level fire certification from the local Fire and Rescue Department and a simple workplace safety self-assessment will be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA). Online electronic portal: National Unified Electronic Tax Service Platform (etax.chinatax.gov.cn), operated by the STA; all tax registration, VAT invoice issuance, filing, export tax refund and non-resident taxpayer procedures are administered through this platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE): (1) Obtain a Business License from the local Administration for Market Regulation; the registration data is automatically transmitted to the competent tax office; (2) Complete tax registration in the National Unified Electronic Tax Service Platform within 30 days after the Business License date, confirming the taxpayer type as a Chinese resident enterprise; (3) Use the Unified Social Credit Code printed on the Business License as the permanent Tax Identification Number (TIN); no separate paper TIN certificate is issued; (4) Appoint a legal representative, open a bank account in China, and complete Corporate Income Tax, VAT, social insurance and local surcharge registrations through the same platform; (5) Register for VAT as a small-scale taxpayer or apply for General VAT Taxpayer status if estimated annual taxable sales exceed CNY 5,000,000; (6) Apply for invoice type, invoice cap and entitlement to issue Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices. For a foreign non-resident entity without a permanent establishment that has China-sourced payments, the TIN is obtained through the withholding agent using the Non-Resident Taxpayer Registration module in the same electronic platform, submitting certificate of incorporation, tax residence certificate, and a written explanation of the China-sourced payments.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC Corporate Income Tax law does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election or a hybrid mismatch entity election for a WFOE; the entity is mandatorily taxable as a Chinese tax resident enterprise on its worldwide income at the 25% rate. The only elective classification is VAT small-scale taxpayer versus General VAT Taxpayer status, which is an indirect tax registration choice, not an entity-level income tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Tax registration is compulsory from establishment without a minimum turnover threshold; every WFOE must register with the competent tax authority within 30 days of Business License issuance. Mandatory General VAT Taxpayer registration applies when annual aggregate taxable sales exceed CNY 5,000,000; taxpayers below this threshold may remain small-scale taxpayers or voluntarily register as General VAT Taxpayers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (FDEI) system. VAT invoices are created through the National Electronic Invoice Service Platform and transmitted to the tax authority in real time. The platform assigns a unique invoice number and cryptographic digital seal, and buyers must verify the invoice on the national invoice verification system before claiming VAT input credits. Paper invoices issued from legacy tax-control devices remain subject to real-time upload through the VAT Invoice Management System; no private invoice rendering, local fiscal stamping or off-platform clearance is recognized. Special VAT invoices for General VAT Taxpayers are subject to online matching and anti-fraud validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports: 0% VAT applies only where the goods are physically exported, the WFOE is the exporter named in the Export Goods Customs Declaration, the goods clear Chinese customs, and the export proceeds are received and repatriated in foreign currency within the statutory period. Offshore services: cross-border regulatory consulting, including FDA 510(k) and CE-mark compliance consulting, qualifies for VAT zero-rating or exemption only if the recipient is a non-resident enterprise or individual, the service is performed for and consumed entirely outside China, no domestic entity in China obtains an economic benefit from the service, and the consideration is paid in foreign currency and repatriated to China. The service must be classified in the Catalogue of Cross-Border Taxable Services for VAT Zero-Rating or Exemption (CaiShui [2016] No. 36, Annex 4, and implementing STA announcements). If the classification or offshore-consumption evidence fails, the STA will reclassify the income as domestic taxable revenue subject to 6% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Customs Declaration Form) submitted through the China International Trade Single Window, or the electronic customs clearance record
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) evidencing physical departure of the goods from Chinese customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or a bank-issued Foreign Exchange Receipt/Return Certificate proving receipt and repatriation of the export collection in foreign currency
Commercial invoice, sales contract and packing list matching the customs declaration

For service exports: cross-border service agreement, statement of work, deliverables proving offshore consumption (for example FDA 510(k) submission acknowledgment, CE technical file documentation, regulatory correspondence), and bank receipts for foreign-currency payments
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, the General Administration of Customs and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange exchange audit data to verify export declarations, VAT refund claims and foreign exchange receipts. Failure to substantiate zero-rating - including missing FIRC, uncollected export proceeds beyond 180 days, false customs declarations, or services actually consumed in China - triggers reversal of the 0% rate, assessment of 6% VAT on the gross revenue, daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day, clawback of any input VAT refunded with interest, administrative penalties of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under the Tax Collection Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, and criminal referral for export tax-refund fraud under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) as the monetary authority, with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the delegated foreign exchange administrative body.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates an IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility regime, meaning trade and service payments, wages, and profit remittances are generally convertible once the bank has verified the underlying transaction documentation. However, the renminbi remains heavily managed and is not freely convertible on the capital account; foreign direct investment, foreign-currency borrowings, outbound investments, and cross-border guarantees all require registration, approval, or filing with SAFE or via delegated commercial banks. Capital inflows such as registered capital are credited to a dedicated foreign-currency capital account and must be registered under the FDI information reporting system before settlement into RMB. Profit repatriation by a WFOE is permitted on a current-account basis, provided the entity has filed annual financial statements, completed corporate income tax settlement, and presents an audited profit-distribution resolution and remittance application to its settlement bank. Historical mandatory export surrender ratios have been abolished; exporters may retain 100% of their proceeds in foreign-currency accounts or convert voluntarily. Nevertheless, the authorities require truthfulness in trade documentation and monitor flows through the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System, imposing substantial penalties for false invoicing or capital-account disguised remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory regime no longer imposes a fixed conversion ratio; the mandatory surrender requirement was fully abolished in 2012. Export proceeds from goods trade must be repatriated to China and received by a domestic bank within the time frame corresponding to the commercial terms, and in practice exporters must complete trade-fx verification within 90 days of the customs declaration date for standard export contracts unless a longer contractual payment period is registered. Enterprises may retain the whole 100% of the foreign currency in their export proceeds settlement account or settle into RMB at their discretion, subject to bank verification and true-matching of customs, contract, invoice, and shipping data.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI Capital Account) and Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account and Export Proceeds Settlement Account
Basic Operational Currency Account and FX Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Legally non-viable as a primary banking rail for a China-domiciled WFOE. Fintech EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Revolut) are not licensed by PBOC or SAFE to provide RMB clearing, domestic current accounts, or capital-account settlement services in mainland China. Their utility is confined to ancillary collection of overseas client payments before conversion into explicit operational inflows; however, all RMB-denominated tax payments, capital injection, and profit repatriation must route through a licensed PRC commercial bank under SAFE verification. Any attempt to use an EMI as the operational treasury account would breach PRC banking law and expose the entity to account freezing and sanctions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a standard WFOE, the statutory legal representative and the designated deputy/manager are required to appear physically in-branch once for biometric/identity verification and to execute reservation of seals (bank chop). Remote opening via consular proxy is not a blanket right; it may be accepted only in exceptional cases if the authorized delegate presents a notarized power of attorney legalized by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate and verified by the bank's compliance department, but most Tier-1 banks retain final discretion to demand an in-person interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear Beneficial Ownership Chain and Ultimate Shareholder opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete certificate of incorporation of the WFOE and all upstream holding entities; notarized and legalized passports or ID copies of all shareholders holding >=25%; updated registered address certificates; group structure chart signed by statutory representative; a declaration of source of wealth for each beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient Economic Substance and Purpose Mismatch for a consulting entity without regulatory license
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan with FDA 510(k) and CE Mark project pipeline; executed consulting contracts with device manufacturers; professional liability insurance certificates; CVs of regulatory consultants; proof of no unlicensed medical practice (e.g., compliance manual, engagement letters differentiating advisory scope).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of Funds and Registered Capital Injection via high-frequency unexplained international wires
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the investor; bank statements covering the last 12 months demonstrating legitimate accumulation of funds; tax residence certificate and tax returns of the investor; a board resolution approving the capital injection; a capital contribution remittance schedule with SAFE-approved purpose code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, And Adverse Media Screening hits on director or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative media search reports from World-Check or equivalent; PEP status declarations and mitigating explanation if any director is a PEP; passport-certified background check reports; confirmation that all clients, final consignees, and manufacturers are screened against UN/OFAC/EU consolidated sanctions lists; a written undertaking to notify immediately if exposure changes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection must be routed via SWIFT wire from the overseas shareholder's bank to the WFOE's FDI capital account (or settlement account) at a designated PRC bank, with the remittance purpose code 'Investment in operating enterprises' (or equivalent SAFE capital-account purpose code). The WFOE must first complete Foreign Investment (FDI) information registration with SAFE at the local branch through the bank, open a capital account based on the registration certificate, and then the CPA in China issues a capital verification report upon receipt. The funds cannot be used before verification; lawful use after settlement is limited to the registered business scope, and funds for non-operating purposes are restricted.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, the WFOE may use SWIFT MT103 wires for direct fee payments and intercompany service fees; Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) are appropriate for procurement of medical device components; Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) for supplier terms; export payments must be supported by customs declarations, contracts and invoices in the Trade Forex Monitoring System, and any advance payment abroad exceeding a threshold requires SAFE filing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB forward (远期结售汇) contracts with licensed banks for current-account exposure up to the notional of verified real trade
RMB FX swaps and cross-currency swaps for both principal and interest hedging, limited to real-demand transactions with maturity matched to cash flows

Foreign exchange options (plain vanilla calls/puts) with real need verification; non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) cannot be registered onshore for domestic entities and are only available in offshore markets, therefore not permissible for the WFOE's domestic bank treasury

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System incorporating the Annual Foreign Investment Information Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, with data sharing to the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), the State Taxation Administration (STA), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the National Development and Reform Commission, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed annual window from 1 January to 30 June covering the immediately preceding financial year; not tied to the registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing places the WFOE on the List of Enterprises Operating Abnormally; if the annual report remains unfiled or unrectified for three consecutive years, the company is moved to the List of Seriously Illegal and Dishonest Market Entities and may face administrative revocation of the business license and deregistration; false or concealed filings may attract administrative fines, market-entry restrictions, banking and customs credit sanctions, and cancellation of tax incentives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return and Self-Adjustment Filing Package including audited financial statements and tax reconciliation schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local competent tax authority under the State Taxation Administration through the Electronic Tax Bureau platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the following tax year; if 31 May falls on a non-working day, the due date moves to the next business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax from the statutory due date; late filing or failure to file may attract administrative fines of up to RMB 10,000, and underpayment attributable to tax evasion is subject to a penalty of 50% to 500% of the deficient amount; the tax authority may freeze bank deposits, deduct outstanding amounts from accounts, seize assets, and restrict the legal representative's exit where a substantial tax liability remains unpaid.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Direct Investment Annual Foreign Exchange Stock and Equity Registration (Foreign-invested Enterprise Foreign Exchange Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange through authorized reporting banks or local SAFE branches
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June of each calendar year for the immediately preceding calendar year; no extension is granted for foreign-invested enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual FDI stock and equity information causes the WFOE to be placed on the SAFE abnormal or restricted enterprise list; the enterprise becomes unable to process foreign exchange capital transfers, dividend remittances, foreign debt payments, outbound investment remittances or bank account transactions until the filing is rectified; administrative warning and monetary fines may also be imposed under the PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory CPA audit of annual financial statements and delivery of the audited financial report to the corporate governance record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No separate government filing is required; the audited statements are retained in the corporate records, presented to the shareholders, and made available to SAMR, the tax authority, banks and forex regulators upon demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual financial statements must be prepared within four months after the fiscal year end; the CPA audit must be completed before the annual shareholders meeting and in all events before the 31 May corporate income tax final settlement deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to complete the statutory audit invalidates the annual corporate income tax filing pipeline, exposes the company to corrective orders and potential fines under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, and may cause the SAMR annual report to be rejected when audited financials are required by lending, tender, forex or government contracting authorities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The WFOE is a PRC limited liability company, and Article 164 of the PRC Company Law imposes a compulsory year-end CPA audit on every company; therefore a WFOE is unconditionally subject to statutory audit and no asset, turnover or headcount exemption exists. Additional quantitative audit triggers under PRC regulatory practice that independently mandate a certified CPA audit include: any listed issuer, NEEQ-listed company, bond issuer, or non-listed public company irrespective of size; any bank, insurance company, securities firm, futures company, fund manager, or payment institution; any enterprise receiving government subsidy or public-interest funding with annual revenue exceeding RMB 50 million, total assets exceeding RMB 50 million, or more than 200 employees; and any enterprise designated by SAMR, STA, SAFE or the securities regulator where its balance sheet total exceeds RMB 30 million or annual turnover exceeds RMB 50 million. The WFOE must in all cases appoint a Chinese CPA firm and conduct the audit under Chinese Certified Public Auditing Standards.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS) for general-purpose financial statements, substantially converged with IFRS; PRC Certified Public Auditing Standards for statutory audits; tax basis adjustments are calculated under the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law and implementing regulations; small-enterprise accounting standards are not a permitted exemption for WFOE statutory audit purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership filing is event-driven rather than separately annual. Under the PRC Measures for Beneficial Ownership Information Management, initial beneficial ownership information is filed at formation, and any change in ultimate beneficial owner, direct or indirect shareholding, voting control, or senior-management controlling person must be reported to the SAMR-based market entity registration authority within 30 days of the change. Annual confirmation is discharged by ensuring the SAMR Annual Report reflects the current UBO and equity structure, by updating the internal share register within 30 days of any transfer, pledge or encumbrance, and by obtaining a formal board confirmation each year that the register of members, register of directors, register of charges and minute book are accurate and complete.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Management Officers
Register of Charges and Mortgages (Security Interests)
Minute Book of Shareholders Resolutions and Board Resolutions
Register of Legal Representative and Company Seal

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 to USD 4,000 per annum for the WFOE registered address and licensed corporate secretary or government liaison service in China
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 to USD 12,000 per annum for a WFOE of typical MedTech regulatory consulting size; higher if consolidated financial statements, cross-border intercompany balances, transfer pricing reports or multiple operating subsidiaries are present

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The effective rate may be reduced by the High-and-New-Technology Enterprise preferential rate of 15% under Article 28 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, the 15% encouraged Western Region rate, the additional 100% super-deduction for qualified R&D expenses, and small low-profit enterprise reduced rates. A WFOE engaged in medical device FDA 510(k) and CE regulatory consulting is not automatically entitled to a patent box, but may obtain a lower effective burden through genuine R&D, qualifying technology services, and substance-based structuring.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 - Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Class A) of the People's Republic of China, together with supplementary schedules such as A105000, A105050, A107010, A107020, A109000, filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration eTax filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final reconciliation with quarterly pre-payments; the annual return is due once per fiscal year, while estimated quarterly instalments are filed throughout the year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be filed within five months after the end of the fiscal year, i.e. for a calendar-year WFOE by 31 May of the following year; quarterly pre-payments are due within 15 days after the close of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue recognised under PRC Accounting Standards for provision of MedTech regulatory consulting services, including FDA 510(k) submission services, European CE marking advisory fees, and related project management income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE is a Chinese tax resident and is taxed on worldwide income. All cross-border service revenue from foreign parent companies or overseas clients must be recognised on an accrual basis, supported by contracts, bank wire confirmations, credit-card settlement records, and foreign exchange registration. Under-reporting cash or merchant income to avoid tax is a criminal offence, and related-party service revenue will be subject to transfer pricing adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of delivering regulatory consulting services, including salaries of regulatory specialists, certification body fees, laboratory testing costs, and allocated overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident outsourcing arrangements, the WFOE must prove that fees to affiliated laboratories, certifiers, or overseas consultants are arm's length and that the services were actually rendered. Deductions require original contracts, invoices, evidence of payment, and customs or immigration documentation where physical testing or travel is involved. Excessive related-party fees are susceptible to recharacterisation as disguised dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 (Lines 4-6 - Selling, Administrative and Financial Expenses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Period expenses including business entertainment, travel, office rent, professional memberships, advertising, bank charges, and borrowing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Business entertainment is deductible only up to 60% of the amount and capped at 0.5% of gross revenue; head-office allocation charges must be rationally allocated and supported by PRC-compliant documents. Interest paid to non-resident shareholders or related parties must pass the debt-equity ratio test of 2:1 for ordinary enterprises, and any disallowed thin-capitalisation interest is treated as a dividend distribution subject to 10% withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 (Lines 9-10 - Investment Income, Asset Disposal Gains and Fair-Value Changes)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment gains, gains on disposal of fixed assets or equity, and changes in fair value of financial instruments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received by the WFOE from other qualified Chinese resident enterprises are exempt from Chinese corporate income tax; dividends from foreign subsidiaries are taxable in China but a foreign tax credit may be claimed. Gain on disposal of equity in a Chinese subsidiary is China-source income and taxable; treaty relief or restructuring deferral is not presumed and must be expressly substantiated under Special Tax Adjustment rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit before income tax reported under PRC accounting standards after incorporating all operating and non-operating income and expense items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must not simply import foreign GAAP books. All statutory adjustments required between PRC accounting profit and taxable income must be tracked in the reconciliation schedules. Non-resident parent entities with a PE of the WFOE abroad do not change the fact that the WFOE's accounting profit is China-taxed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 (Lines 15-16 - Tax Adjustment Additions and Deductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary differences, including non-deductible fines, excess entertainment, fair-value adjustments, unrealised foreign-exchange losses, impairment provisions, and intercompany pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-deductible items include corporate income tax itself, late-payment surcharges, criminal fines, bribes, unlawful invoices, and provisions without objective evidence. Cross-border intercompany charges should be recorded in accordance with the matched-contribution and benefit-recognition standards; any upward transfer-pricing adjustment by the tax authority over a related-party service will appear in this reconciliation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 (Lines 17-18 - Exempt Income, Reduced Income, Additional Deductions and Loss Carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-exempt interest, qualified dividends, income using reduced tax rates, R&D super-deductions, and deduction of prior-year losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward for five years only; foreign-source losses are not available to shelter Chinese-source profit because China taxes worldwide income but uses the credit method. R&D super-deductions apply only to qualifying R&D activities actually performed in China, not to services subcontracted to a foreign parent unless an arm's length cost-sharing arrangement and contemporaneous documentation exist.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after all book-tax adjustments, exemptions, deductions, and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must file a complete transfer pricing contemporaneous report if any statutory related-party threshold is exceeded. A negative taxable income does not extinguish the obligation to file complete schedules, and tax authorities may propose an adjustment even in loss periods when cross-border transactions are not arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 (Lines 20-24 - Tax Rate, Tax Payable, Preferential Tax and Tax Credits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory 25% headline rate applied to taxable income, reduced by preferential rates, exempt reductions, and equipment investment tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A High-and-New-Technology Enterprise certificate only helps if the WFOE genuinely employs Chinese technical staff, owns R&D, and receives its core regulatory-consulting income from qualifying activities. Foreign tax credits for withholding taxes suffered abroad must be capped by the PRC tax payable on the same foreign income and supported by tax payment certificates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 (Lines 25-28 - Foreign Income Tax, Foreign Tax Credit, Prepayments and Final Balance Payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed on foreign-source income, offset by eligible foreign tax credits, reconciled with quarterly prepayments, and final balance due or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE as withholding agent for its non-resident shareholder must withhold enterprise income tax at 10% on any dividend distribution resolution, paying the withholding tax to the State Taxation Administration within 7 days of the date of distribution. For interest and royalty remittances to non-residents, the WFOE must withhold and remit tax under Article 37 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, and may apply the relevant Double Tax Agreement rate only if the non-resident has satisfied all procedural treaty relief conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return under Article 62 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law carries a fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to 10,000 in serious cases. Any unpaid tax accrues a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%. Tax evasion under Article 63 carries a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, plus recovery of the tax and surcharge. Criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law may result in imprisonment of up to 3 years and a fine where evaded tax exceeds 10% of taxable income and RMB 50,000; imprisonment of 3 to 7 years applies where the amount exceeds 30% and RMB 500,000. Legal representatives and actual controllers may be placed on the blacklisting and exit-control systems for unpaid tax liabilities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory dividend withholding tax on distributions by the WFOE to non-resident enterprise shareholders, levied under Article 37 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced withholding rate under a bilateral Double Tax Agreement, the non-resident shareholder must (i) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence from the tax authority of its home jurisdiction, (ii) complete the treaty-benefit information reporting procedure in the Chinese e-filing system or by filing Form SA? No, use exact description: complete the Information Reporting Form for Tax Treaty Benefits, (iii) prove beneficial ownership by demonstrating real entitlement to the dividends, active substance, capacity to manage and dispose of the income, and absence of a contractual or legal obligation to pass the income on to a person in another jurisdiction, and (iv) retain the entire supporting file, including annual reports, shareholding register, board resolutions, bank statements, and substance evidence, for at least 10 years. Since 2015 China operates a self-assessment treaty relief system: no advance approval is required, but if the relief is later found to be unwarranted, back-up withholding, interest, penalties and treaty-abuse recharacterisation apply.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax is 10% for cross-border interest and royalties paid to non-residents; many Chinese DTAs reduce interest to 5% or 10% and royalties to 5% or 10% subject to beneficial ownership. Royalties for patents, know-how, software copyright, or trademarks connected with FDA 510(k) or CE technical files are China-source. Interest on shareholder loans is subject to thin-capitalisation limits, and excess interest may be recharacterised as dividends with full 10% withholding and without treaty interest relief.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Contemporaneous Local File is statutorily required when annual related-party transactions exceed any single threshold under SAT Public Notice [2016] No. 42: RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers, and RMB 40 million for related-party service fees. Master File is required when the group's annual consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 2 billion and the Chinese entity is part of an MNE group that prepares Country-by-Country reporting or has significant cross-border related-party transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not apply the Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations, but applies an explicit substance-over-form doctrine through Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, the Special Tax Adjustment Measures, and the General Anti-Abuse Rule. For a medical-device regulatory consulting WFOE, the Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) include contract negotiation, regulatory strategy formation, FDA submission preparation, CE technical file drafting, project management, risk assumption and client-facing scientific decision-making. The WFOE must have premises, qualified staff, decision-making records and cash-flow controls in China; without real economic substance, tax authorities may deny treaty benefits, disregard shell entities, disregard intercompany allocations, impose withholding back-up, and recharacterise profits as taxable dividends.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Concealment of Revenue or Fictitious Costs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE intentionally omits service revenue from FDA 510(k) and CE regulatory contracts, understates credit-card or bank-wire proceeds, fabricates laboratory or certification expenses, or gives false custom declarations to shrink taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law and Article 63 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, the tax authority recovers the underpaid tax, imposes a daily surcharge of 0.05%, and levies a administrative fine of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, if the evaded amount exceeds 10% of taxable income and RMB 50,000, imprisonment is up to 3 years plus fine; if it exceeds 30% and RMB 500,000, imprisonment is 3 to 7 years plus fine.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced under Article 23 of the PRC Company Law where a shareholder or director abuses the WFOE's independent legal personality to evade taxes. Directors who signed false declarations or directed concealment face joint and several civil liability for restitution of the unpaid tax and fines, asset freezes, travel-ban blacklisting under the dishonest judgment debtor system, and criminal imprisonment of up to 7 years for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Invoicing and False Documentary Evidence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE accepts, issues or circulates false VAT invoices, counterfeit expense receipts, forged FDA 510(k) submission dockets, or fictitious CE-marking invoices for payments that never occurred, in order to inflate deductions and avoid corporate income tax and VAT output tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Issuing or obtaining false special VAT invoices violates Article 205 of the Criminal Law, and issuing false unspecified invoices violates Article 205-1; penalties include fines and imprisonment up to 15 years or life imprisonment in especially serious cases. The false invoices are wholly non-deductible, input VAT credits are denied, and Article 63 penalties of 50% to 500% of evaded tax apply on top.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, financial controllers and legal representatives who sign or order false documentation cannot hide behind the corporation. Article 23 of the Company Law allows courts to impose joint personal civil liability for all unpaid tax and penalties, and criminal liability extends to personal imprisonment, confiscation of personal assets, restitution to the treasury, and inclusion on international or domestic travel-blacklist enforcement systems.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Treaty Abuse and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is maintained as a letterbox entity with no real office, no qualified regulatory staff, and no substantive service performance; it routes royalties, interest or consulting fees to a parent or conduit in a tax-favoured jurisdiction solely to reduce Chinese tax or to claim an unwarranted reduced dividend withholding rate under a Double Tax Agreement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and the Special Tax Adjustment Measures empower the State Taxation Administration to make an adjustment, deny the treaty benefit, recharacterise the transaction, impose interest, and if the adjustment was caused by wilful concealment or false disclosure, apply the 50% to 500% evasion penalty. Fraudulent use of a forged tax residency certificate additionally triggers criminal liability for forged official documents under Article 280 of the Criminal Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the sole shareholder or managing director is the real principal of the shell structure, cannot prove independent books, bank accounts and assets, or commits fraudulent treaty declarations, the court pierces the corporate veil and orders the individual to assume joint liability for all unpaid Chinese tax, civil restitution of diverted profits, asset disclosure and judicial freeze, exit-control travel blacklisting, and criminal imprisonment for tax evasion or document forgery.
